kills.property: After initialization, MinSum cannot be changed.
kills.change_summary: Delete the entire if block guard so that SetMinSum always updates MinSum even after initialization.

kills.property: After initialization, a subsequent call to SetMinSum reverts on the original but succeeds on the mutant.
kills.change_summary: Replace the revert statement with an assignment to MinSum inside the if block, so the guard sets a fixed value instead of reverting.
